title: Dhao language
description: Language spoken on Ndao island Indonesia
extract: The Dhao language, better known to outsiders by its Rotinese name Ndao, is the language of Ndao Island in Indonesia. It is a member of the Sumba language in the Austronesian family. It was once considered a dialect of Hawu, but is not mutually intelligible.
